title: [finding] AGENTS.md says a draft conversion removes a PR from the merge queue — every measured queued draft in this repo stayed queued and merged (Prime Directive #14's pull-back rests on it)
body:
Filing gate: **① a governed text measured false**, with named landing sites.

`reach:` every seat that follows Prime Directive #14 to pull back an armed or queued governed PR. It converts to draft, trusts that this removes queue membership, and moves on. The harm is already realized: PR #20695 merged in draft, with `Console Pin Gate` red in its queue build (cards #20646 / #20747).

Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat 1 (`session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`, seat post #7623) from the #20764 dev report (out-of-scope finding 1). The seat re-read two timelines itself. PR #20845 (#20764) corrects the same reading in `platform-readings.md` only; `AGENTS.md` is Tier H and outside that claim. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The texts (at `origin/main`)

1. `AGENTS.md:285-:286`, Prime Directive #14: "Convert it back to **draft** AND disable auto-merge — draft is what removes queue membership, disabling alone drops only the arming".
2. `AGENTS.md:428`, the "State on your PR" paragraph: the draft flag "flipped back destroys auto-merge and queue membership".
3. `AGENTS.md:532`, multi-agent §7: "**flipping back to draft drops auto-merge and queue membership at once**".

## Measured (timeline events, `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/N/timeline`)

- **#6732**, re-read by the seat: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-08-08T14:01:50Z, then `convert_to_draft` 14:04:32Z, then `merged` + `removed_from_merge_queue` 14:38:56Z. It merged 34 minutes after the conversion, while still a draft, with no dequeue in between.
- **#20695**, re-read by the seat: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-09-29T23:32:51Z, then `convert_to_draft` 23:57:02Z, then `merged` + `removed_from_merge_queue` 2026-09-30T00:04:21Z. It merged in draft 7 minutes later.
- **The dev's scan** (read-only timelines over #4700-#4900, #6650-#6850 and #20400-#20840):
  - Four queued PRs were converted to draft: #6732, #20420, #20442 and #20695. None was removed by the conversion. Two merged while still in draft. The other two left the queue only after their own merge-group builds went red, and #20442 was rebuilt into a new group 9 minutes after its draft.
  - Three armed-but-unqueued PRs were converted to draft: #4745, #6727 and #6829. Each logged `auto_merge_disabled` within 1 s.
  - So the "drops auto-merge" half holds only for an UNQUEUED PR.
- **Both acts together** (draft + auto-merge disable), on #6732, #20420 and #20442, were not seen to dequeue either. Caveat: on a queued PR the disable leaves no timeline event, so that it was sent rests on the seats' own comments.
- **The one removal measured without a red build** was a maintainer's manual removal (#20797, `removed_from_merge_queue` 2026-09-30T07:33:36Z, no draft conversion).

## What changes

- The three sentences must stop stating that a draft conversion, or draft + disable, removes queue membership. This is rule text only; the measurements live in `platform-readings.md` (PR #20845) and the PR body, per AGENTS.md's header rules.
- **Open question, for triage (it may need a maintainer):** Prime Directive #14 has no measured working eviction act in this repo. The #20764 dev's options are:
  - **A.** Keep "draft + disable" as the act, rely on the positive queue-ref probe plus not-on-`main` to detect a failure, and escalate a queued governed PR to the maintainer for a manual removal.
  - **B.** Card a relay op for GraphQL `dequeuePullRequest`. That is a new capability, so it needs a maintainer ruling.

  The dev recommends A for now.

## Dedupe

Semantic issue search in this repo, open and closed:
- "AGENTS.md draft conversion removes merge queue membership PR merged while draft governed": 97 hits. The only open one on this reading is #20764 (the `platform-readings.md` half, PR #20845); none is about the AGENTS.md sentences.
- "dequeuePullRequest merge queue eviction remove queued PR": 21 hits. #12873 and #12888 (closed) are about reading queue membership from refs, not about the eviction act.

Dedupe words: `AGENTS.md draft queue membership` · `convert_to_draft merge queue` · `draft removes queue membership` · `Prime Directive 14 pull back queued`
